facts.fact: The president of Burkina Faso's Commission de l'Informatique et des Libertes (CIL), Dr Halguieta Nassa/Trawina, hosted and signed the operational roadmap of the AES data protection authorities' coordination framework with Mali's APDP and Niger's HAPDP on 18 November 2025.
